item.title: Modest Mouse Replaces Guitarist Simon O’Connor Amid Allegations
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news in the music world. Today, we're discussing Modest Mouse, the indie rock band that's been making waves in the music scene. The band has just announced some changes to their upcoming North American tour.
[Music transitions to a softer tone]
Host: In a statement posted on Instagram, Modest Mouse revealed that guitarist Simon O'Connor will not be joining them on tour due to allegations of sending inappropriate social media messages to a minor. The band has decided to replace O'Connor with Seth Jabour, guitarist of Les Savy Fav.
[Music pauses for a brief moment]
Host: The allegations against O'Connor surfaced on Reddit, where a 17-year-old user claimed that the guitarist sent them an erotic image and commented on their bikini pictures, which were taken when they were 16. O'Connor has responded to the allegations, stating that he opposes any sexual behavior towards minors and claiming that he mistakenly believed the user was someone who had been trolling him in the past.
[Music starts playing again]
Host: Modest Mouse is set to embark on their North American tour on August 4th, in support of their eighth studio album, "An Eraser and a Maze". The tour will wrap up on October 24th in Sacramento. While the band hasn't provided further details about O'Connor's status, they're looking forward to performing with their new guitarist, Seth Jabour.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. We'll keep you updated on any further developments. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!
